description: The standings table a team sits in — every team in the conference with its conference and overall records and placement, not just this team's own line (maxpreps_get_team gives that). Also returns the ranked statistical leaders MaxPreps highlights for the season. Read-only.

season.description: Season label, e.g. 25-26. Omit for the current season.

team.description: Team site path or URL, e.g. nc/charlotte/myers-park-mustangs/football

name: maxpreps_get_standings
title: Get conference standings
